propositions: Multiple tests in test_build_provenance.py rebuild identical clean-source artifacts with git archive and python -m build four times per test run, causing 35.93s execution time with 65%+ redundancy.

Establish a session-scoped per-worker fixture that performs one git archive and one real python -m build with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234, returning only immutable read-only artifact paths (wheel and sdist).

Wheel-from-sdist and sdist-content tests reuse shared real artifacts while preserving archive-content assertions; install-from-sdist and empty-env-failure tests perform distinct function-local builds.

A deterministic call-count oracle confirms exactly one successful prerequisite build per pytest worker/session; defect-seeded duplicate builds and missing COMMIT mutations fail their respective oracles.
